descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S25 「养老院 Consult 预选 SNF consult（唯一有闸门的格子）」 Nursing Home Consult pre-selects SNF consult (the one gated cell)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Nursing Home Consult pre-selects SNF consult (the positive cell only; 'never SNF admission / SNF discharge' is U8)（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 6；TFA-92599 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Session fixture; the Nursing Home resident untouched

When Set the resident to Consult in the chart header and look at Note Format on the Encounter tab

Then SNF consult is the pre-selected template

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-06 'Consult -> Consult note / SNF consult' + TFA-92584 AC 6 + TFA-92599 AC 2. One checkpoint, so the gate (TFA-92599 in progress) covers only this cell. SNF consult does not exist on main, so the expected verdict is Fail (known: TFA-92599 AC 2). 'Never SNF admission or SNF discharge' for this cell is U8 (not gated), judged in S02

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
